from w3lib.http import basic_auth_header
from w3lib.html import get_meta_refresh

html = (
    '<html><head>'
    '<script><meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0;url=evil.html"></script>'
    '<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="3;url=next.html">'
    '</head></html>'
)
refresh = get_meta_refresh(html, "http://example.com/path/index.html")
headers = [basic_auth_header("Aladdin", "open sesame"), basic_auth_header("user", "pass")]
state = [(refresh[0], refresh[1]), [header.decode() for header in headers]]

print(state)
print([item.split()[1][:4] for item in state[1]])
print(state[0][1].replace("index.html", "x"))
